exceptions.reason: picomatch ReDoS through a crafted glob, with no patched release (every version through 4.0.7 is affected). GitHub withdrew the advisory on 2026-11-18, but npm audit still reports it. The attack needs an attacker-supplied glob. picomatch reaches the console only through development tools (vite and its React plugin, vitest, tinyglobby and typescript-eslint), which compile patterns from the console's own config files; none of them ships in the app the bot embeds, and the built app contains no picomatch code.
